sections: Atomic layer deposition of dielectric Y 2 O 3 thin /uniFB01 lms from a homoleptic yttrium formamidinate precursor and water †
Y2O3 ALD process development with [Y(DPfAMD)3] and water

figures.caption: Fig. 1 Representation of the water-assisted thermal ALD processes employing di /uniFB00 erent precursors. Black: cyclopentadienyls, red: homoleptic yttrium amidinates and guanidinates, blue: heteroleptic yttrium isopropyl-cyclopentadienyl amidinates, green: heteroleptic yttrium ethyl-cyclopentadienyl amidinates. 12 -15,17 -20
Scheme 1 Molecular structures of the yttrium precursors [Y(DPfAMD)3] (this study), [Y(DPAMD)3], [Y(DPDMG)3].
Scheme 2 Proposed EI-MS fragmentation pattern for [Y(DPfAMD)3] showing the most stable fragment [Y(DPfAMD)2] + .

Fig. 2 Top: TG analysis of [Y(DPfAMD)3] (black), [Y(DPDMG)3] (blue) and [Y(DPAMD)3] (red). Bottom: vapor pressure measurements for all three complexes. The dotted grey line represents the 1 torr vapor pressure.

Fig. 3 Dependence of (a) GPC on temperature and the critical angle Q c obtained from XRR and (b) thin /uniFB01 lm thickness as a function of number of applied cycles including a linear /uniFB01 t ( R 2 ¼ 0.9999). (c) Dependence of GPC versus precursor pulse length at 200 /C14 C(red) and 300 /C14 C (black). (d) Dependence of GPC versus precursor purge length at 200 /C14 C (red) and 300 /C14 C.
Fig. 4 GI-XRD pattern from a 43 nm Y2O3 thin /uniFB01 lm deposited at 300 /C14 C on Si(100) and re /uniFB02 ections assigned according to ICSD 185295.

Fig. 5 Left: AFM image of a 20 nm Y2O3 thin /uniFB01 lm deposited at 300 /C14 C on Si(100). Right: XRR curve from the latter thin /uniFB01 lm with the simulated curve and obtained thin /uniFB01 lm parameters such as thickness, roughness, and density.

Fig. 6 XPS core levels recorded for a 60 nm thick Y2O3 thin /uniFB01 lm grown at 300 /C14 C(upper row: as deposited; lower row: after sputtering). (a + e) O 1s core level regions, (b + f) Y 3d core level regions, (c + g) C 1s core level regions and (d + h) overlapping N 1s and Y 3s core level regions.

Fig. 7 UV-Vis measurements conducted with Y2O3 /uniFB01 lms (20 nm) deposited at 300 /C14 C. (a) Absorbance in dependence of the wavelength and (b) Tauc plot for the determination of the optical direct band gap from the ( a h n ) 2 term.
Fig. 8 Typical C -V and G -V characteristic of Y2O3 MIS capacitors with a diameter of 70 m mmeasuredat 1 MHz. The 24 nm Y2O3 /uniFB01 lm was deposited at 300 /C14 C.
Fig. 9 Capacitance -voltage curves of Y2O3 MIS capacitors with a diameter of 70 m mfor frequencies f ¼ 1 kHz, 10 kHz, 100 kHz and 1 MHz. The 24 nm Y2O3 /uniFB01 lm was deposited at 300 /C14 C.
